description: React component for configuring cost tracking settings, including provider-specific discounts; manages fetching, updating, and displaying discount configurations.

methods.name: fetchDiscountConfig
methods.description: Fetches the current discount configuration from the server.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the current discount configuration to the server.

methods.name: handleAddProvider
methods.description: Adds a new provider with its discount to the configuration.

methods.name: handleRemoveProvider
methods.description: Removes a provider from the configuration.

methods.name: handleDiscountChange
methods.description: Handles updates to individual provider discount values.
